title: Move-Out Accounting Note: Days Charged on the Final Package Fee and the Resident's Notice to Vacate
content:
# Days Charged on the Final Package Fee — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package

**Note.** On the final package fee line of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account, the days charged depend on the resident's notice:

1. **Long notice, date kept.** When a notice to vacate on the lease's completed final term (the Lease Term Agreement in completed status) was received at least 60 days before the service end date and the Apartment Home Lease's move-out date is the move-out date that notice named, the service end date itself is not charged and the days charged are the days of responsibility less one.
2. **No notice.** When the lease's completed final term carries no notice to vacate, the whole 30-day month is charged: 30 days.
3. **Every other situation.** The days charged are the days of responsibility.

The days charged are the proration days the final package fee line records. The days of responsibility of the final period are the days from the period-end water read of the last period that carries a package fee line to the service end date.

## Situations

| Notice on the completed final term | Received 60 or more days before the service end date | Lease move-out date equals the named date | Days charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | days of responsibility less one |
| yes | yes | no | days of responsibility |
| yes | no | any | days of responsibility |
| none | — | — | 30 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical service end date August 31, 18 days of responsibility)

- Notice received July 2 (60 days before), named move-out August 31, lease move-out August 31: 17 days.
- Notice received July 3 (59 days before), same dates: 18 days.
- Notice received June 1 naming August 31, while the lease's move-out date is August 25 (the service end date then being August 25, with 12 days of responsibility): 12 days.
- No notice on the completed final term: 30 days.
